scope: Norm-implied outer intervals for sqrt(I_0/I_-1), not rho masses or full-bootstrap feasible intervals.

derivation.raw: Tangency to (A-a)^2+(B-b)^2<=eps^2 gives ratio endpoints (ab +/- eps sqrt(a²+b²-eps²))/(a²-eps²).
derivation.relative: Apply the same geometry to (A/a,B/b) centered at (1,1).
derivation.normalized: Normalized-target disk contains the origin; arbitrarily small positive moments realize every support-compatible ratio as an outer possibility.
derivation.support: For the positive measure rho(s)ds/s on [4,s0], 4<=I0/I-1<=s0.
derivation.resonance: Identifying the spectral mean with a rho mass needs narrow-resonance dominance, not used in this audit.
